item.title: How toxic haze is causing Singapore’s landmarks to disappear
item.description: The BBC’s Tessa Wong breaks down how one of Indonesia’s worst wildfire seasons is impacting countries around South East Asia.

item.title: What Americans think about the death penalty

item.title: Watch: Why was the sign at the British consulate in East Jerusalem removed?
item.description: The consulate, first established in 1838, was set to be closed by the Israeli government in retaliation for UK sanctions.

item.title: ​​USS Lincoln finally docks in San Diego after 10-month mission
item.description: The US aircraft carrier was set to return in May but the war with Iran has kept it at sea on one of the longest deployments ever.

item.title: She made India fall in love with women's cricket - now her era as captain is over

item.title: Why Zimbabwe tycoon 'Sir Wicknell' was loved and hated in Africa
item.description: Wicknell Chivayo divided opinion in life and continues to do so in death.

item.description: Many Palestinians are still living in cramped tent cities, with the US plan to end the war largely stalled.

item.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies

item.title: Arizona congressional candidate says she was raped while repairing campaign sign

item.title: Residents airlifted to safety after flooding in central Chile
